The Verse of the Elder Anūpama:
“The mind that comes seeking delight is as if being impaled on a stake.”
"Wherever you go, you will go to the stake and the crossbar; therefore,
I call him a betrayer of his own mind:
the Teacher, so difficult to find, has been obtained by you;
do not lead me into a state of pride.”
